items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: I'm talking about things I did with Dinah Shore, Nellie Lutcher ... you know.

ctx.x: Because, you know, what really broke me up was the idea that many miles from the USA, and they still knew my brother, and you know, they just idolized him; all the records, everything. And it's kind of -- it's an education for you because you just do not imagine that people know about you ... as I think I told you about when we first went to England.

They could tell you every ... some of the questions I could not answer for you, they could answer them in England. They know every record date you have ever played on. As a matter of fact, I have the book someplace, if I go downstairs and try to find it -- but they gave me one. They gave me a little book of every record date I had played on. I'm talking about things I did with Dinah Shore, Nellie Lutcher ... you know.
This is one that has been published? Or one they made up for you?
